svg.title: Recover entries on a fresh installation
svg.desc: Recovery requires both local vault files to be absent. The backup passphrase authenticates the backup, new credentials and Recovery Key are confirmed, then a new DEK and vault pair are committed. Failures stop; no existing vault is overwritten.
